cityHall.name: Tandag City Hall
cityHall.note: `status` governs the PHONE and EMAIL ONLY. Both are INVENTED and deliberately unusable — 000-0000 is not a dialable subscriber number and .invalid is a reserved TLD that can never resolve — because tandag.gov.ph does not resolve and no citizen's charter has been obtained. The contact section renders them as non-links with a visible notice while status is 'placeholder'. Flip to 'verified' in the same commit that replaces both values with sourced ones; the UI turns them into tel:/mailto: links with no code change. `address` and `mapUrl` are NOT placeholders: both were supplied directly by the project owner and render as a real link regardless of this flag.
